title: MiDAS: A Multimodal Data Acquisition System and Dataset for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
abstract: arXiv:2602.12407v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Background: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RMIS) research increasingly relies on multimodal data, yet access to proprietary robot telemetry remains a major barrier. We introduce MiDAS, an open-source, platform-agnostic system enabling time-synchronized, non-invasive multimodal data acquisition across surgical robotic platforms.   Methods: MiDAS integrates electromagnetic and RGB-D hand tracking, foot pedal sensing, and surgical video capturing without requiring proprietary robot interfaces. We validated MiDAS on the open-source Raven-II and the clinical da Vinci Xi by collecting multimodal datasets of peg transfer and hernia repair suturing tasks performed by surgical residents. Correlation analysis and downstream gesture recognition experiments were conducted.   Results: External hand and foot sensing closely approximated internal robot kinematics and non-invasive motion signals achieved gesture recognition perform

translated_title: MiDAS：一种用于机器人辅助微创手术的多模态数据采集系统与数据集
translated_abstract: 摘要：背景：机器人辅助微创手术（RMIS）研究日益依赖于多模态数据，但获取专有机器人遥测数据仍是一个主要障碍。我们引入了MiDAS，这是一个开源、平台无关的系统，能够在手术机器人平台上实现时间同步、非侵入式的多模态数据采集。方法：MiDAS集成了电磁和RGB-D手部追踪、脚踏板感应以及手术视频捕获，无需依赖专有机器人接口。我们在开源Raven-II和临床da Vinci Xi系统上，通过采集外科住院医师执行的转移桩和疝修补缝合任务的多模态数据集，验证了MiDAS的性能。进行了相关性分析和下游手势识别实验。结果：外部手部和脚部感应紧密接近内部机器人运动学，非侵入式运动信号实现了手势识别性能。
tldr: MiDAS提出了一种开源、平台无关的非侵入式多模态数据采集系统，无需专有接口即可同步获取手部、脚部和视频数据，并在多种手术机器人上验证了其有效性和手势识别性能。
en_tdlr: MiDAS introduces an open-source, platform-agnostic non-invasive multimodal data acquisition system that synchronizes hand, foot, and video data without proprietary interfaces, validated across surgical robots for effective gesture recognition.
